gcp.bigquery.multi.query.eu.note: On-demand analysis per TiB scanned in the EU multi-region. The first TiB of query data processed a month is free ("The first 1 TiB of query data processed per month is free", https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/pricing), counted over the billing account. The Billing Catalog lists the free tier as a $0 first tier on each location's SKU; the page gives it once per billing account, so a declaration that reads two locations is given it twice.
